retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style folk album cover featuring band members depicted as uncanny marionettes with visible strings and joints, paired with bulbous psychedelic lettering.
excludeWhen: modern digital flat design is required

recipe.visualDefinition: Four male figures rendered as wooden marionettes with articulated jaw lines and ball-jointed limbs, wearing matching green turtlenecks and dark trousers. They are suspended by thin vertical black strings against a textured off-white background. The composition is topped by heavy, interlocking psychedelic display type with thick black drop shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical strings connecting the figures to the top edge of the frame
Interlocking letterforms forming a cohesive horizontal block
Matching green apparel creating a unified group identity
Musical instruments integrated into the puppet poses
coreInvariants: Heavy black drop shadows on all display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged in a loose horizontal row across the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, colorful psychedelic title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the heavy title down the vertical strings to the puppet faces, then across the instruments.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white space surrounding the central cluster of puppets and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subjects and text against a low-saturation, high-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Letters must interlock or overlap tightly
Thick black offset drop shadow creating a 3D effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'S' characters feature exaggerated curves that nestle into adjacent letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the heavy display type with a clean, wide-set grotesque sans-serif for secondary metadata.
graphicDevices: Small blue square bullet points for lists

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 60s psychedelic weight and curvature

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gouache-style illustration of four men as marionettes with ball joints and visible jaw seams, wearing green turtlenecks and playing folk instruments (banjo, guitar, accordion), suspended by black strings against a cream paper background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom bulbous psychedelic lettering in vibrant colors with a thick black drop shadow at the top center. Add secondary metadata in a clean sans-serif font like Helvetica Wide.

verificationChecks: Are the puppet joints clearly visible?
Does the text interlock without gaps?
Is the background a textured off-white?

postGenerationChecks: Check for visible puppet jaw lines
Ensure text has a heavy black drop shadow
Verify the presence of vertical marionette strings
Confirm the 'all hung up' theme is visually represented by the strings
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject as Marionettes] + [Green Turtlenecks] + [Vertical Strings] + [Bulbous Psychedelic Lettering] + [Gouache Texture]
